name: Embention Sistemas Inteligentes, S.A.
summary: Embention Sistemas Inteligentes, S.A develops autopilot systems and critical avionics for autonomous vehicles. The company offers autopilots products, including flight controllers, simulation, and visual navigation systems; avionic products comprising I/O expansions and sensors, DC-DC converters, and datalinks; motor controllers for eVTOL and manned aircraft; ground control stations; and tracking antenna systems. It also provides autopilot training courses, autopilot configuration and HIL models, complementary support, onsite engineering, remote engineering, continuous engineering, certification support, and airfield and facilities rental services.
